properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
A present fault cannot command the feeder.
Automatic restart count stays within the budget.
Accepted reset clears history and leaves the feeder stopped.
Lockout requires a safe explicit reset.
Lock out on Fault from RUNNING once reference attempts already reached 2 (uses Spre.attempts to stay immune to candidate undercounting).
On fault-free retry dwell completion, restart Run and output Attempts = Spre.attempts + 1.
A fault during recovery clears progress and prevents restart.

properties.formula: G(((qIdle & normal & !(Start & !Fault)) -> (!Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)) & ((qIdle & normal & Start & !Fault) -> (Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)) & ((qRunning & !Fault & normal) -> (Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)))
properties.description: Eliminates vacuous under-counting and missing IDLE/RUNNING forward constraints.

properties.formula: G(((normal & qWait & !retryDue) -> (!Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)) & ((!qLocked & !(qRunning & Fault & normal & refAttempts=2)) -> !Locked) & (!(Run & Locked)))

properties.description: Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.Run: O[k].Run: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Locked: O[k].Locked: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Attempts: O[k].Attempts: independently observed post-scan candidate value (USINT); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.first: k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation
atomic_propositions.qAttempts: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].Attempts", "initial": 0, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Attempts; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.retryDue: Spre.reference.state.mode=2 AND NOT I[k].Fault AND Spre.reference.state.free>=1
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_SELF012(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
mode=IDLE/attempts=0/free=0初值。优先Reset & !Fault & !Start清全部；其次LOCKED保持；其次Stop回IDLE并清free但保留attempts；RUNNING且Fault转WAIT或已重试2次转LOCKED；WAIT中Fault清free否则加1，free>=2时attempts加1并回RUNNING、free=0；IDLE且Start & !Fault进RUNNING。输出Run/Locked取新mode，Attempts取新attempts。
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.mode=IDLE, O_init.Run=false, O_init.Locked=false, O_init.Attempts=0.
